text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
......Whew...
With this level of preparation...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: HA-YA-HI-DEEEEE~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Good work!
That was an absolutely fantastic run in today's race!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"While I was running, I chased after them with all my might,
but I couldn't reach them at all, not even close..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"You're just too strong, really...!
*sniff*..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Bud, nex' time I'm gonna wiiin~

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's true.
Let's both keep giving it our best from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After the race. While preparing
icing supplies for Biwa Hayahide...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...How was it?
How did I look today through your eyes?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I think so too.
Having overcome the summer, a new strength—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
N-No. I am fine.
Nothing is out of the ordinary in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I just felt happy, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I wished to win with all my might,
and my legs answered the call.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm not like I was back then,
tripping over my own feet trying to overtake them...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"With how I am now, will I be able to
catch up to the back of the one who overtook me?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Because that is why we've worked on our formula for victory."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...To defeat Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Two months remain until the Arima Kinen.
The stage for the sisters' clash that she wished for is finally at hand.
